name: Times cryptic crossword, Times Crosswords book 1 No 22

clue.text: Return of Verdi’s opera incomplete without very great singer
Special offer with cost finally reduced? That’s natural
Depression in the land so long
Criminal came and left in disguise
Washerwoman needs to use soft soap, putting in cape
Stout is to be served inside
Seat for parlourmaid?
A pedlar, so we hear, is never taking it so easy on the road
Mocking religious leader leaving this order
One reckons new university projection’s 100 short
Terminate old arrangement? It depends on the strings attached
Exempt from charge to cross river
Evidence provided that’s getting rid of monarch
Part of cathedral, say — such as Ely?
Swoop down ‘on honky-tonk with a lot of money
Changing a lot, and not particularly nice about it?
Money is stolen from a saint
Toss up on part of square
Way to deal with sin etc.
Detective has to have permit for peephole
One whose charges are small for easy task
I0Us, possibly, for such gems?
Open spaces standard for martial art
Birds from the freezing poles
A piece of armour said to inflict injury
Blurred shot
Finish off sauce on prawn cocktail — cover all over
Transport system Parisians look down on?
